content: Dokopa Kamongome Mosese lamaiyuo, Dakepa nambame Perao kando mende pingi pyapono doko pao kandalale. Perao banya kingi porai dokome banya yuu doko yaki nyuo pena lapala wambu dupwa poraiyuo suu lanyi nembara, leya.
Anatumi Mosese lamaiyuo, Kamongo doko namba lyakande, leya.
Namba Anatu Porai Wakasa dokoŋo lao Aporakamemoo Aisake Jekope keta epo paneyo. Nambana kingi Yawai lenge lao rangeme sinya lao lamai nayo lyakande.
Nakama yuu Kenane nakama mee upunili palima paenge ingyuo epo papiyami doko mairuŋu lao kana minyuo lalu lao leyo.
Dopako pyuo Isaraelena rara dupwa Isipi akali dupwame karapusi pyaminyipa randa nao ingi koo palyuo karaminyi dokona kandapala nambana kana minyuo lalu lao leyono pii dokona suu pyaro karoŋo.

Dokona lao embame Isaraele wambu dupwa lamaiyuo Kamongo doko nambaŋa. Nakama Isipi dupwame karapusi pyuo yulu nyuo suu lao joo karaminyi dokona nambame nakama karapusi yulu pyakamyuo karaminyi dokona kingi rekya lao nyero. Nambana kingi porai dokome nakama pyao rekya lalana pyuo karo dokome nakamba randa koo maipala nakama kyawa lete nyero.

Dopa pyuo nakama namba rangena ingyuo nyepala namba nakamana Anatu ingyuo kararo. Dokopa namba nakamana Kamongo Anatu dokome Isipi wambu dupwa randa joo kareyaminyipa moko nyii kande dokolyamo lao serami, leya.

Dopa pyuo lao, Nambame yuunde Aporakame Aisake Jekopemoo mairuŋu lao kingi ketae nembo lalu lao leyono dokona nakama rangena kipungi inginya lao jero. Namba Kamongo doko karo letamo lao lamairi, leya.
Dokopa Moseseme pii doko Isaraele wambu dupwa lamaiyamopape nakama karapusi yulu kopetame maiyaminyi pyuo karapala makame kumuo kareyami dokome pii doko soo nyii nayami.
Emba Isaraele wambu dupwa kingi raka lao yaki nyinya lao Isipi wambunya kiŋi Perao baa lamaiyala puu, leya.
Dopa leyamopape Moseseme Kamongo lamaiyuo, Isaraele wambu dupwame nambana pii soo nembami kandapi doko doŋo dee Peraome apa pyuo nambana pii doko serase? Namba pii angingyuo laa nange kandapi, leya.

Pii doko soo kaeyo Kamongome Mosese Eronepa lamaiyuo, Isipi wambunya kiŋi Peraomoo Isaraele wambu dupwape Kamongome Isaraele wambu yuu Isipi doko yaki nyuo lanyuo pupwa lapyasa epelyambano larambi, leya.
6:14-27 Lipaena rara dokona wai kiso nyuo Eronepa Mosesepa kareyambi. Dee Eronena para pyao nyiyamo wambu lapona kingi pyasi palamoko.
Kamongome Mosese Eronepa Kando Dopa Pinya Leya
Kamongome yuu Isipi dokona Mosese lamaiyuo,
Namba Kamongo doko, Pii peparae nambame langilyu dusipa minyuo pao yuu Isipi wambunya kiŋi doko lamaipi, leya.
Dopa leyamo dokopa Moseseme Anatu kando lao, Namba pii lalana yakara pingi doko emba silini. Apa pyuo kiŋi dokome nambana pii serase? leya.
